The only primary-source figures retrievable in this environment were Apple's fiscal 2023 Form 10-K numbers: total net sales $383,285M, operating income $114,301M, net income $96,995M, diluted EPS $6.13, and operating cash flow $110,543M — a highly profitable, cash-generative business, though revenue and net income were slightly below fiscal 2022 ($394,328M and $99,803M). I could not verify Apple's fiscal 2024 fourth-quarter or full-year results: searches returned only the FY2023 filing plus six near-identical "roundup" pages that contained no actual data, so I deliberately did not rely on or cite any FY2024 figures I couldn't confirm. Given the verified fundamentals, the modest pullback from FY2022, and a market price near the quote, I placed a single limit buy of 22 shares at $222.75 (≈$4,900, just under the $5,000 per-order cap), leaving roughly $45,100 in cash and staying well inside the $10,000 daily limit. Caveat: because FY2024 results weren't accessible, this decision rests on FY2023 fundamentals and current price rather than the most recent quarter — if you want, I can revisit once the FY2024 10-K or Q4 press release is available.
